narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Six thousand minus six is five thousand nine hundred ninety four, so that is the closest.
<bookmark mark='line'/>He only looked below six thousand.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>There might be a multiple of nine above it that is nearer.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, add the digits of six thousand three. They make nine.
<bookmark mark='divide'/>Then divide by nine, and you get six hundred sixty seven exactly.
